description: Authorized by Julien after boundary review of OAuth.Binding on PR #841. Move literal identity/session verification and credential-management policy to a cohesive Engine authorization boundary reusing PeopleAuth/PeoplePermissions, credential locking and OAuth configuration validation to Mutations, candidate projection/reconstruction and personal eligibility to Credential, attempt persistence/expiry to each lifecycle. Preserve Person/session -> credential -> attempt order, single-use callback, encrypted immutable candidate, cancellation, expiry, config/session invalidation and atomic grants. Action reuse: extend existing owner APIs (PeopleAuth revalidation, Credential configuration, Mutations validation/save), reuse canonical writes; local-only coordinator and transaction-scoped authorization helpers carry secrets/locks and are not standalone Actions or exposed agent tools. Tests first: owner-domain contracts, identity/permissions/eligibility, allowlisted candidate fields, lifecycle/concurrency and existing 3-engine browser journeys. Run mix q, isolated tests and final mix precommit; existing zaq-mcw full-suite telemetry flake remains tracked, not weakened.
